use_case: General-purpose generative AI assistant used at the bench to suggest likely faults from symptoms, error logs, and screen photos, and to draft customer text messages and quote explanations
vendor_or_model: Generative AI assistant vendor (general-purpose large language model; consumer plan until 2026-09-30, then a business plan with no-training terms or stop)
data_categories: Symptoms; device error logs; screen and board photos; ticket notes. History review found customer first names, copied ticket notes with passcodes, and screen photos showing notifications
consequential_decision_category: None (repair diagnosis and customer service); influences the repair and price a customer is quoted
human_in_the_loop: Owner inspects and tests the device and confirms the fault before any quote; owner edits and sends every customer message personally; AI never contacts customers
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(n) (data use, unneeded repairs) and 45(a)(1) (any AI claims); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) (security of personal information pasted into the tool)
status: In production since 2026-02; approved with conditions 2026-08-31

use_case: Ticketing vendor's website chatbot add-on: answers booking and price questions and gives ticket status
vendor_or_model: Ticketing and POS vendor (generative chatbot add-on over the shop's FAQ and price list)
data_categories: Customer questions; names; ticket numbers; anything customers type (3 of 41 trial chats contained device passcodes)
human_in_the_loop: Owner reviewed transcripts after the trial; no live handover existed during the trial
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1) (prices and AI disclosure) and 45(n); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) and (6) (chat data; vendor as third-party agent)
status: Retired (14-day trial 2026-05-05 to 2026-05-19; not adopted; transcript deletion requested 2026-08-03)
